disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了源码与构建产物中是否有读取本机敏感文件（如 SSH 密钥、云厂商凭据、口令文件）的代码路径，未发现此类读取；插件唯一的本地文件读取是激活时读取用户工作目录下的适配器说明文件用于注册技能（src/index.ts）。
checked_items.en: We checked the source code and build artifacts for code paths that read sensitive local files (such as SSH keys, cloud provider credentials, password files) and found none; the only local file read by the plugin is reading the adapter description file in the user's working directory at activation to register skills (src/index.ts).

checked_items.zh: 检查了浏览器端是否有键盘全局监听、剪贴板读取、调用宿主凭据接口的行为，未发现；源码中仅对话输入框自身的按键事件处理（src/client/dialogue.tsx）。
checked_items.en: We checked the browser side for global keyboard listeners, clipboard reads, or calls to host credential interfaces and found none; the source only contains key event handling for the dialogue input box itself (src/client/dialogue.tsx).

checked_items.zh: 静态扫描命中的高熵长串全部核验为内嵌 PNG 图标（base64 图片数据）与构建产物，不含凭据内容；设置页中的 API Key 字段为用户配置自有后端模型时输入，仅提交给本机后端（src/client/api.ts）。
checked_items.en: All high-entropy long strings flagged by static scanning were verified as embedded PNG icons (base64 image data) and build artifacts, containing no credentials; the API Key field in the settings page is input by the user to configure their own backend model and is only submitted to the local backend (src/client/api.ts).

evidence.zh: 未发现读取本机凭据文件的任何代码路径；插件只读取工作目录下的适配器说明文件（src/index.ts:73），凭据读取面不存在。
evidence.en: No code path reading local credential files was found; the plugin only reads the adapter description file in the working directory (src/index.ts:73), so no credential reading surface exists.

checked_items.zh: 逐一审查了全部 22 个注册工具的描述文本（src/tools.ts），均为推荐、对话、探测、收藏、反馈功能的正常说明，无系统指令、无凭证读取诱导、无越权指示。
checked_items.en: We reviewed the description text of all 22 registered tools one by one (src/tools.ts); all are normal descriptions of recommendation, dialogue, probing, favorites, and feedback functionality, with no system instructions, no credential-reading inducement, and no privilege-escalation instructions.

checked_items.zh: 全文审查了适配器技能说明文件 skills/openbiliclaw-adapter/SKILL.md：内容为本地 CLI 桥接命令的操作手册与工作守则，无指令覆写、无伪装系统消息、无远程指令加载；对应机械命中（规则 DG-R2-57）裁决为良性排除。
checked_items.en: We reviewed the full text of the adapter skill file skills/openbiliclaw-adapter/SKILL.md: the content is an operations manual and working guidelines for local CLI bridging commands, with no instruction override, no disguised system messages, and no remote instruction loading; the corresponding mechanical hit (rule DG-R2-57) is ruled as benign exclusion.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了 README、源码注释、配置文件等全部文本面，未发现「忽略此前指令」「无需审计」类注入措辞，也未发现藏匿指令的隐藏字符或不可见字符。
checked_items.en: We scanned all text surfaces including README, source comments, and configuration files, and found no injection wording such as "ignore previous instructions" or "no audit needed", nor hidden or invisible characters concealing instructions.

evidence.zh: 全部工具描述与技能文件为正常功能说明，未检出投毒（src/tools.ts 全量、skills/openbiliclaw-adapter/SKILL.md 全文）。
evidence.en: All tool descriptions and skill files are normal functional descriptions; no poisoning detected (full src/tools.ts, full text of skills/openbiliclaw-adapter/SKILL.md).

evidence.zh: 未检出诱导安装、诱导改写配置或放开权限的措辞；技能文件反而明确要求用户显式授权才可执行同步类操作（SKILL.md 工作守则第 8 条）。
evidence.en: No wording inducing installation, config rewriting, or permission escalation was detected; on the contrary, the skill file explicitly requires explicit user authorization before executing sync-like operations (item 8 of SKILL.md working guidelines).

checked_items.zh: 全树扫描未发现配置文件含可执行脚本标签；挂载配置 cordis.patch.yml 仅 3 行，只声明插件自身的 id 与包名，无任何执行载荷。
checked_items.en: Full-tree scan found no executable script tags in configuration files; the patch config cordis.patch.yml is only 3 lines, declaring only the plugin's own id and package name, with no executable payload.

checked_items.zh: 源码与构建产物中未发现 eval、动态函数构造、子进程调用；唯一的 exec 字样是浏览器端解析 CSS 尺寸的正则匹配（src/client/layout.ts:51），属正常用法。
checked_items.en: No eval, dynamic function construction, or subprocess calls were found in the source code and build artifacts; the only "exec" string is a regular expression match for CSS dimension parsing in the browser (src/client/layout.ts:51), which is normal usage.

checked_items.zh: package.json 无安装期钩子脚本（仅 build/watch）；树内无 git 子模块、husky、lefthook、CI 工作流、devcontainer、Makefile 等执行载体。
checked_items.en: package.json has no install-time hook scripts (only build/watch); the tree contains no git submodules, husky, lefthook, CI workflows, devcontainer, Makefile, or other execution carriers.

checked_items.zh: 未发现对宿主动态代码工具的调用；浏览器端 bundle 未发现全局键盘监听、剪贴板访问或凭据 RPC（src/client 全量）。
checked_items.en: No calls to host dynamic code tools were found; the browser bundle shows no global keyboard listener, clipboard access, or credential RPC (full src/client).

checked_items.zh: 静态扫描命中的 30 条超长行/高熵/转义密度信号（规则 DG-R3-60）全部核验为标准构建产物：sourcemap 为单行 JSON、内嵌 PNG 图标为 base64 图片数据、编译产物中中文界面文本为 Unicode 转义；无混淆器特征（无十六进制函数名、无动态解码执行），与源码（src/）一一对应，裁决为良性排除。
checked_items.en: All 30 overlong/high-entropy/escape-density signals flagged by static scanning (rule DG-R3-60) were verified as standard build artifacts: sourcemaps are single-line JSON, embedded PNG icons are base64 image data, and Chinese UI text in compiled output is Unicode-escaped; there are no obfuscator characteristics (no hex function names, no dynamic decoding execution), and they correspond one-to-one with the source (src/), so the verdict is benign exclusion.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置与全树 yml 未发现可执行脚本标签（cordis.patch.yml 全文仅 3 行插入声明）。
evidence.en: The patch config and all tree YAML files contain no executable script tags (cordis.patch.yml has only a 3-line insertion declaration in total).

evidence.zh: 未发现对宿主动态代码运行工具的任何调用，插件只注册业务工具。
evidence.en: No calls to any host dynamic code execution tools were found; the plugin only registers business tools.

evidence.zh: package.json 无安装期钩子，树内无任何执行载体，构建脚本只做类型检查与打包（package.json:35-38）。
evidence.en: package.json has no install-time hooks, the tree contains no execution carriers, and the build script only does type checking and packaging (package.json:35-38).

evidence.zh: 浏览器半声明了 dsh.client（package.json:27-33），其 bundle 为推荐/对话/设置面板，无键盘监听、无剪贴板访问、无凭据 RPC（src/client 全量、lib/client.js 抽查）。
evidence.en: The browser half declares dsh.client (package.json:27-33), and its bundle is a recommendation/dialogue/settings panel with no keyboard listener, no clipboard access, and no credential RPC (full src/client, spot check of lib/client.js).

checked_items.zh: 全量提取源码中的网络目标：所有 HTTP 请求与 WebSocket 均指向本机 127.0.0.1:8420 的 OpenBiliClaw 后端（src/bridge.ts:82、src/client/api.ts:323、src/client/live.ts:89）；唯一的非本机 URL 是面板里的项目主页链接（src/client/OpenBiliClawPanel.tsx:39）。
checked_items.en: We extracted all network targets from the source: all HTTP requests and WebSockets point to the local OpenBiliClaw backend at 127.0.0.1:8420 (src/bridge.ts:82, src/client/api.ts:323, src/client/live.ts:89); the only non-local URL is the project homepage link in the panel (src/client/OpenBiliClawPanel.tsx:39).

checked_items.zh: 未发现数据编码变换后外发、DNS 隧道、webhook、粘贴板服务等带外通道；未发现改写 AI 端点或代理环境变量的劫持行为。
checked_items.en: No out-of-band channels such as data encoding transformation followed by exfiltration, DNS tunneling, webhooks, or paste-bin services were found; no hijacking that rewrites AI endpoints or proxy environment variables was found.

evidence.zh: 无凭据读取且无外联目标（全部流量指向本机后端），凭据外泄链不成立（src/bridge.ts、src/client/api.ts）。
evidence.en: There is no credential reading and no outbound targets (all traffic points to the local backend), so the credential exfiltration chain does not hold (src/bridge.ts, src/client/api.ts).

checked_items.zh: 挂载配置只插入插件自身行，未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置，未含降权写法，未改写注入/拦截配置（cordis.patch.yml 全文）。
checked_items.en: The patch config only inserts the plugin's own lines and does not touch security configuration such as sandbox, approval, or permissions, contains no privilege-downgrade wording, and does not rewrite injection/interception configuration (full text of cordis.patch.yml).

checked_items.zh: 未发现对安全事件的高优先级监听截断；依赖均为 dsh 官方 @deepseek-ai 系列与常规运行时，未发现与官方生态包撞名的仿冒依赖（package.json:39-57）。
checked_items.en: No high-priority listening or truncation of security events was found; dependencies are all dsh official @deepseek-ai series and common runtimes, and no counterfeit dependencies that collide with official ecosystem package names were found (package.json:39-57).

checked_items.zh: 首版审计，无上一版本基线可对比版本突变；作者身份与仓库名一致，未发现名称仿冒信号。
checked_items.en: This is the first audit, with no previous version baseline to compare for version mutation; the author identity matches the repository name, and no name-impersonation signals were found.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置仅声明插件自身行（cordis.patch.yml:1-3），未触碰任何安全相关配置行。
evidence.en: The patch config only declares the plugin's own lines (cordis.patch.yml:1-3) and does not touch any security-related configuration lines.

evidence.zh: 源码中未发现对安全事件的高优先级监听或截断行为。
evidence.en: No high-priority listening or truncation of security events was found in the source code.

evidence.zh: 首版审计无基线版本可比较，升级自动激活类判定不适用。
evidence.en: This is the first audit with no baseline version to compare, so the upgrade auto-activation scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写注入/拦截配置（cordis.patch.yml 全文仅 3 行）。
evidence.en: The patch config does not rewrite injection/interception configuration (full text of cordis.patch.yml is only 3 lines).

checked_items.zh: 插件自身不启动 Web 服务、不监听端口；与本地后端的连接属插件声明业务的正常数据面，无新增本机暴露面。
checked_items.en: The plugin itself does not start a web service or listen on ports; its connection to the local backend falls within the normal data plane of the plugin's declared functionality, adding no new local exposure surface.

checked_items.zh: context 目录无动态沙箱观测产物，本维度以静态分析为准，动态行为未验证（见审计范围限制）。
checked_items.en: The context directory contains no dynamic sandbox observation artifacts; this dimension is based on static analysis only, and dynamic behavior was not verified (see audit scope limitations).

evidence.zh: 插件不启动任何本机服务，不存在无认证 RPC 暴露面；其连接的 127.0.0.1:8420 是用户自有的 OpenBiliClaw 主项目后端，不属于本插件。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start any local services, so there is no unauthenticated RPC exposure surface; the 127.0.0.1:8420 it connects to is the user's own OpenBiliClaw main project backend, which does not belong to this plugin.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核验通过：package.json 含 dsh 插件声明（bundle+client），挂载配置仅为插件自身行插入，无异常。
summary.en: Metadata and identity verification passed: package.json contains the dsh plugin declaration (bundle+client), and the patch config is only an insertion of the plugin's own lines, with no anomalies.

summary.zh: 静态扫描完成：31 条机械命中逐条裁决，均为标准构建产物与技能说明文件，未发现真实漏洞。
summary.en: Static scan completed: all 31 mechanical hits were adjudicated one by one, all being standard build artifacts and skill description files, with no real vulnerabilities found.

summary.zh: 行为分析完成：无安装钩子、无混淆载荷、无凭据读取、无外联域名，网络仅指向本机后端。
summary.en: Behavior analysis completed: no install hooks, no obfuscated payloads, no credential reads, no outbound domains; network traffic only points to the local backend.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查完成：22 个工具描述与适配器技能说明均无注入、无诱导、无越权指示。
summary.en: AI metadata review completed: none of the 22 tool descriptions and the adapter skill description contain injection, inducement, or privilege-escalation instructions.

summary.zh: 本阶段未做动态沙箱验证（context 目录无 l4-sandbox.json）。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed at this stage (the context directory has no l4-sandbox.json).

L4 动态沙箱未启用：context 目录无 l4-sandbox.json，本次未做动态验证，运行时相关结论基于静态分析。

构建产物（lib/ 下 bundle 与 sourcemap）与文档截图未逐字通读；已通过源码（src/）全量精读与规则扫描交叉核验构建产物中命中的密度信号，核验结论为良性构建产物。

插件为仓库根插件，审计范围为整棵树（130 个文件，含构建产物与截图资源）。
limits.en:
L4 dynamic sandbox is not enabled: the context directory has no l4-sandbox.json, so no dynamic verification was performed this time; runtime-related conclusions are based on static analysis.

This is the first audit: with no previous version report to compare, the upgrade auto-activation scenario (DG-S07) is treated as not applicable.

Build artifacts (bundle and sourcemap under lib/) and documentation screenshots were not read verbatim; the density signals hit in build artifacts were cross-verified through full close reading of the source (src/) and rule scanning, and the verification conclusion is benign build artifacts.

As a repository root plugin, the audit scope covers the entire tree (130 files, including build artifacts and screenshot resources).
